record_type_quote: We collected data starting from the original study period, tracking the largest 300 firms listed by Fortune in the year 1990, the same sample criteria used in Beckman et al. (2004); however, we track this set of firms for a longer period of time, through 2010.

targets.authors: Beckman CM, Haunschild PR, Phillips DJ
targets.title: Friends or strangers? Firm-specific uncertainty, market uncertainty, and network partner selection.
targets.evidence_quote: To do so, we replicate the original Beckman et al. (2004) study, taking the analysis a step further to track the original sample firms through 2010.
targets.outcome_quote: Our baseline replication of their analyses in the time frame of the original study matched closely with their results, providing evidence to corroborate their initial findings within that sample time period. Interestingly, our analyses across a longer sampling period yielded strikingly different results.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Direct replication agrees, but the later-period and full-period analyses contrast with original findings. These are aggregated as mixed.

reasoning: Recollected and extended firm-year data test Beckman et al. One original paper; other replication citations supply methodological context.
